title: Net quantity expressed in a correct standard unit symbol
plain: The quantity uses the correct unit symbol
plain_action: Check the symbol as printed: it is "g", "kg", "ml", "l" -- lower case where shown, no full stop, and never a plural such as "gms".

citation.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) read with the Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
citation.text: The net quantity shall be expressed in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, using the unit symbol prescribed for that unit.

messages.pass: The net quantity uses a prescribed unit symbol.
messages.violation: The net quantity is expressed using a non-standard unit symbol. Prescribed symbols are case-sensitive, are not pluralised, and do not take a full stop.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
